title: Evidence and limits
body:
v0.1-dev8 shipped recorded native ooRexx r13196 tests including ConnectSelector dev1/dev2/dev5 and Intention Service dev11, JSON writer, promotion negatives. This historical evidence has not been independently rerun on 2026-10-23.

v0.1-dev9 checked shell test entrypoint syntax, 26 JSON files, manifest (87 member files) and ZIP integrity. New test_ssc_receipt.rex was authored, but could not be executed because the supplied ooRexx .deb has no retrievable backing bytes in the active runtime and no local rexx executable was found.

Current GitHub commit publishes the architecture sphere and dev9 source delta; full v0.1-dev8-derived code archive remains a separate conversation artifact, not an asserted GitHub-accepted source snapshot.

No production SSC adapter, real signed approval, target deployment qualification or NotNotes publication has been tested. Never label an externally assumed proof as live acceptance.
summary: v0.1-dev8 shipped recorded native ooRexx r13196 tests including ConnectSelector dev1/dev2/dev5 and Intention Service dev11, JSON writer, promotion negatives. This historical evidence has not been independently rerun on 2026-10-23.
invariants: Architecture selection and review never authorize execution
Unknown qualification fails closed and remains visible
Each external component retains its own semantic and provenance authority

provenance.claim: Exact historical baseline; no new runtime acceptance
